cards.title: Our Unchanged Game Plan
cards.html:
Simplicity is the signature of truth. Our strategy has remained remarkably consistent: own more of the best, monetize volatility without losing core, recycle proceeds into the same FCF titans.

Core Philosophy

  • Concentrate in The27 — one best-in-class FCF compounder per major sector
  • Hold for decades, not quarters
  • Only adjust when competitive moats deteriorate
  • Reinvest realized gains back into proven winners

Execution Excellence

  • Sell premium in volatility without giving up ownership
  • Strategic hedging during market dislocations
  • Tax-efficient harvesting and redeployment
  • Alignment through co-investment

Light Volume Masking Institutional Accumulation

cards.title: Implications for The27
cards.html:
Demand Broadening and Deepening

AI infrastructure demand is no longer confined to hyperscalers. Enterprise adoption is spreading across healthcare, logistics, and finance. Every name in The27 either builds AI infrastructure or deploys it to drive margin expansion.

Oracle-style wins earlier this year set the template — now spreading to managed care (UNH leveraging AI for claims), logistics (UPS route optimization), and payments (V/MA fraud detection).

Record Operating Leverage

Across our holdings, revenue growth in the mid-to-high single digits is translating to double-digit+ FCF growth. NVDA, GOOGL, META, and AMZN all demonstrated this dynamic in recent quarters.

The "efficiency era" is real — and our FCF-first lens positioned us perfectly to capture this margin expansion wave.

cards.title: Policy Guardrails: Disciplined Framework
cards.html:
Our risk framework balances conviction with prudence, ensuring we can maintain positions through volatility while protecting against tail risks.

Coverage Requirements

  • Target maintenance coverage ≥1.05× normal course
  • Target ≥1.15× into macro events and FOMC meetings
  • Automatic deleveraging triggers if coverage falls below 1.0×
  • Monthly stress testing against historical volatility scenarios

Option Strategy Limits

  • Sell-the-Wall® sizing caps at 30–50 bps per tenor per name
  • Roll early if assignment risk exceeds 25% ITM probability
  • Every premium dollar recycled into The27 ownership ↑, cost basis ↓
  • Maximum 30% of position in any single expiration cycle

cards.html: Why Absolute FCF Growth Matters
cards.text: Why Absolute FCF Growth Matters

cards.title: Free Cash Flow: The Ultimate Truth
cards.html:
In a world of accounting gimmicks and adjusted metrics, free cash flow remains the purest measure of business quality. It represents actual cash generated after all investments required to maintain and grow the business.

Operating Cash Flow

Cash generated from core business operations after working capital changes

Minus Capital Expenditure

Required investments in property, plant, equipment, and technology

Equals Free Cash Flow

Discretionary cash available for dividends, buybacks, debt reduction, or reinvestment

Companies that generate large and growing free cash flows possess pricing power, operational excellence, and durable competitive advantages. These are the only businesses worth owning for the long term.

cards.title: Why Absolute FCF, Not Relative Metrics
cards.html:
Most investors focus on margins, multiples, or growth rates. We focus on the absolute dollar amount of free cash flow and its growth trajectory. This distinction is critical.

The Problem with Relative Metrics

A company with 50% FCF margins generating $100M is less valuable than a company with 20% margins generating $10B. Relative metrics can mislead by focusing on percentages rather than absolute wealth creation.

Similarly, 100% growth from $1M to $2M is less impressive than 10% growth from $50B to $55B — the latter adds 2,750× more absolute cash.

Our Absolute FCF Focus

We seek businesses generating tens of billions in current FCF with ability to grow that number by billions annually. NVDA growing FCF by $40B in two years creates more value than 1,000 small companies combined.

This focus on absolute scale plus growth leads us naturally to The27 — the elite aces of aces generating the most cash and growing it fastest.

cards.title: The Compounding Power of FCF Growth
cards.html:
When absolute FCF grows consistently, the compounding effect creates extraordinary wealth over time. This is the essence of our long-term strategy.

Year 1: $10B FCF

Starting with a business generating $10B annually in free cash flow

Year 3: $13.3B FCF

At 10% annual growth, FCF expands to $13.3B — adding $3.3B in new cash generation

Year 5: $17.7B FCF

Compounding continues, now generating $17.7B annually — $7.7B more than start

Year 10: $28.5B FCF

After a decade, annual FCF nearly triples to $28.5B — creating massive value

This is why we focus relentlessly on businesses with both large current FCF and high growth rates. The combination creates exponential value creation over our multi-decade holding period.
